errors.description: error_bundle_q is a multi-bit value produced in block_clk and sampled directly in service_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
fault_pulse_q is a one-cycle block_clk pulse consumed directly in service_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
fault_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample service_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in service_event_o.
mask_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector mask_mode_q before decoding in service_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
block_rst_n is used as data inside service_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
trace_snapshot_q combines block_clk payload state with service_clk status state in trace_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
